text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, are you marvelous?? I already 
know the answer☆ You're totally marvelous, 
right?★☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh, who? What? Wait a second—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You, you, and you are all Marvelous☆ I 
know★ After all, today is a special day☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, who are you!? What on earth is 
marvelous!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You see, Marvelous is a wonderful 
surprise☆ And I'm the Umamusume who shows 
you what's Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race is gonna be an extra special 
Marvelous!☆ After all, today is the 
long-awaited first—"
choice_data_list: Marvelous, get back to the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The day of the Make Debut has finally 
arrived. Marvelous Sunday is in the 
absolute best of spirits."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment you take your eyes off her, she 
goes around making Marvelous appeals to 
anyone and everyone, keeping me on edge 
all morning.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha, ahahahahahaha☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you☆ How are you doing★ I am 
feeling super marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because today is the start of the 'World 
Marvelous Project'☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
With my marvelous running, I'll deliver 
marvels to everyone☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha, ahahahahahaha☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What an intense girl...! Could she be 
the one making all that racket over there 
earlier...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea what she was talking 
about... What was it again, World 
Marvelous...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because it's a completely new 
concept to them, the spectators look 
utterly bewildered by the repeated chants 
of "Marvelous!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, it can't be helped. They simply 
don't know the potential of "Marvelous" 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, as "Marvelous" spreads, we'll 
surely hear shouts of "Marvelous" from all 
over the place—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, Trainer! I'm so excited☆ I'm itching 
to go★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how far it'll reach? Will I be 
able to make it reach them?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The world is full of Marvelous☆ If you 
find the Marvelous, everyone can be 
happy★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to realize it a second 
sooner☆ The potential for happiness that 
every single person holds!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's why—
choice_data_list: Go give it your all in your Make Debut!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Watch closely, Trainer! Today, I'll 
pay you back with a wonderful, marvelous 
time too☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: âAh, but before that...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm just gonna run to the bathroom real 
quick!
